description: A shell script for setting up and managing Docker-based environment for the OpenClaw project, including configuring directories, building/pulling images, starting services, setting sandbox mode, and other setup tasks.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Prints an error message and exits.

methods.name: require_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command is available in the system.

methods.name: run_docker_build
methods.description: Builds a Docker image using BuildKit.

methods.name: is_truthy_value
methods.description: Determines if a value is considered true.

methods.name: read_config_gateway_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from a JSON config file.

methods.name: read_env_gateway_token
methods.description: Reads the gateway token from an environment file.

methods.name: ensure_control_ui_allowed_origins
methods.description: Configures the allowed origins for the control UI.

methods.name: sync_gateway_mode_and_bind
methods.description: Sets the gateway mode and bind configuration.

methods.name: run_prestart_gateway
methods.description: Runs a command in the gateway container.

methods.name: run_prestart_cli
methods.description: Runs a CLI command in the gateway container.

methods.name: run_runtime_cli
methods.description: Runs runtime CLI commands with specified scope and dependencies.

methods.name: contains_disallowed_chars
methods.description: Checks if a string contains control characters.

methods.name: is_valid_timezone
methods.description: Checks if a timezone string is valid.

methods.name: write_extra_compose
methods.description: Generates an extra Docker Compose file with volume mounts.

methods.name: upsert_env
methods.description: Updates or adds environment variables in a file.
